text:
Maya (Design): quick design review — noticed export CTA in trace viewer feels ambiguous when header is collapsed. users expect download to be next to session actions, not buried in the top-right toolbar.
Kevin (Product): +1 saw a support ticket where someone couldn't find correlation IDs in the exported CSV.
Sam (Eng runtime): what if export lived in the drilldown kebab menu? less visual noise but still discoverable.
Maya (Design): leaning toward kebab + a modal. modal should include a checkbox: 'Include correlation IDs and span metadata'. default checked for enterprise.
Aisha (Accessibility): also need clear screen-reader text for that checkbox. current export button just says "Export" which is ambiguous.
Maya (Design): proposed aria example: 
```
<button aria-label="Export trace data. Opens export options" id="export-btn">Export</button>
<label for="incl-corr">Include correlation IDs</label>
```
Sam (Eng runtime): sounds good. technically we already include corr IDs in backend but they get stripped if user selects compact export. we can wire the checkbox to preserve them.
Kevin (Product): product question — should the modal have a compact vs full export radio? customers asked for a small CSV for quick pivots.
Maya (Design): yes: radio: Compact (tokens, timestamps) vs Full (all span metadata). default: Compact for free tier, Full for paid. label copy needs to be explicit.
Aisha (Accessibility): phrasing suggestion: 'Compact — summary CSV (faster download, fewer columns)' and 'Full — complete trace export (includes correlation and span-level data)'. also keyboard focus order must be modal -> checkbox -> export button.
Sam (Eng runtime): note: exporting full traces can be heavy — we should show a warning if file > 10MB and offer async email download.
Kevin (Product): agree. also add telemetry event: export_started with field include_correlation_ids=true/false. helps ops triage.
Maya (Design): mockup posted: https://redwood.infra/mockups/trace-export-opts.png (see top-left modal). feedback?
Aisha (Accessibility): contrast on the modal primary button is low on the mock. make primary #0055aa per brand palette; also add focus ring outline for keyboard users.
Sam (Eng runtime): small implementation note: keyboard shortcut 'E' when focus is on trace list should open export modal. need to ensure it doesn't conflict with existing shortcuts.
Kevin (Product): anyone object to moving inline 'download snapshot' from header into kebab?
Maya (Design): no objections. keeps header decluttered and groups export actions.
ui-bot: deploy:trace-export-ui v2 pushed to staging at 1712468120 :rocket:
Sam (Eng runtime): tested on staging — modal appears, checkbox persists in localStorage, file size warning shows. failing UX: CSV column order changes between Compact and Full which broke one customer script.
Maya (Design): suggestions: if column order differs, show preview sample (first 3 columns) in modal so users know what they'll get.
Kevin (Product): add to roadmap: export preview + API flag to request stable column ordering.
Aisha (Accessibility): final nit — include aria-describedby linking the warning text to the export button when file-size warning appears.
Maya (Design): thanks all. I'll update the mock and copy. follow-ups: (1) Sam to add telemetry and warning; (2) Aisha to write SR copy; (3) Kevin to add API flag ticket. Back in 2 days for sign-off. :thumbsup:
